source: decider_catalog.es.v1.json + ProductCatalog.cs, written 2026-10-15; 2026-10-15 reglas de uso añadidas tras el banco de práctica (sin copiar sus frases)

tools.app.close: Close one window of an application that is already open, gracefully; never force-kills the process. Use when: the person asks to close an app or its window. Do not use when: closing every window (use window.close.all), force-killing a hung program (use system.process.terminate.named), closing a web page (use browser.control). Examples: «cierra el spotify», «ciérrame la calculadora», «close chrome».
tools.app.installed: Check whether a normal application is installed on this PC, without opening it. Use when: the request is a question about an app being installed. Do not use when: the person wants it opened (use app.open), the target is a game (use game.installed.named), or asks if it is open right now (use window.application.status). Examples: «¿tengo instalado el zoom?», «¿está instalado discord?», «is obs installed?».
tools.app.open: Open an application or game launcher by name (Steam, Epic Games, Discord, Spotify, Notepad, Calculator) and verify its window gets focus. Use when: abre/open/inicia an app or launcher. Do not use when: asking if installed (use app.installed or game.installed.named), playing a game (use game.launch), playing music or video (use media.play.query or streaming.play.named), an already open window (use window.focus), a file (use file.open). Examples: «abre steam», «ábreme el discord», «open spotify». Set foreground true so the person sees it, and forControl true; set forControl false only when the person asks to run it as administrator. Never set place or placeValue.
tools.audio.app.volume.adjust: Raise or lower one application's volume (its mixer slider) by an amount from its current level; master volume untouched. Use when: an app is named with sube/baja/más/menos and an amount. Do not use when: an exact target level (use audio.app.volume.set), no app named (use audio.volume.adjust). Examples: «bájale 20 al spotify», «sube el volumen de discord en 10», «turn down chrome by 15».
tools.audio.app.volume.set: Set one application's volume (its mixer slider) to an exact level 0-100, even while paused; master volume untouched. Use when: an app is named with a target number or percent. Do not use when: raising or lowering by an amount (use audio.app.volume.adjust), no app named (use audio.volume). Examples: «pon el spotify al 30», «discord al 50 por ciento», «set chrome volume to 20».
tools.audio.microphone.mute: Mute or unmute the default microphone (sound input). Use when: the person mentions the micrófono or mic. Do not use when: muting the speakers or headphones (use audio.mute). Examples: «silencia el micrófono», «activa el micro de nuevo», «mutea el mic».
tools.audio.mute: Mute or unmute the PC sound output (speakers or headphones). Use when: silencia, mutea or quita el silencio for the sound in general. Do not use when: the microphone (use audio.microphone.mute), pausing what plays (use media.control), changing the level (use audio.volume or audio.volume.adjust). Examples: «silencia el pc», «quítale el mute», «mute the sound». This is the operation for silencing the whole PC or computer: silencing never turns anything off.
tools.audio.status: Read which audio output is in use, its volume and whether it is muted, without changing anything. Use when: the person asks the current volume or where the sound comes out. Do not use when: changing the volume (use audio.volume or audio.volume.adjust), asking which song plays (use media.status). Examples: «¿en cuánto está el volumen?», «¿por dónde sale el sonido?», «¿está muteado el pc?».
tools.audio.volume: Set the PC master volume to an exact level 0-100. Use when: a target number or percent is given («al 50», «en 30»), even with the verb sube/baja. Do not use when: raising or lowering by an amount from the current level (use audio.volume.adjust), one app only (use audio.app.volume.set), muting (use audio.mute). Examples: «pon el volumen al 50», «volumen en 20», «sube el volumen al 80».
tools.audio.volume.adjust: Raise or lower the PC master volume by an amount from its current level. Use when: sube/baja/más/menos with an amount and no target level. Do not use when: a target level is given with «al N» or «en N» (use audio.volume), one app only (use audio.app.volume.adjust). Examples: «sube el volumen 10», «bájale 20 al volumen», «turn it down by 5».
tools.backup.create: Make a private, verified backup copy of one file already identified by BAXY (resource id and hash). Use when: backing up a single file found earlier. Do not use when: a whole known folder (use backup.known.create), zipping (use file.compress). Examples: «haz un respaldo de ese archivo», «sácale una copia de seguridad al informe», «backup ese archivo».
tools.backup.known.create: Create a verified ZIP backup of a known folder: desktop, documents, pictures, projects or all of them. Use when: respaldar or backup of a whole folder. Do not use when: backing up one single file (use backup.create), just zipping a file or folder next to itself (use file.compress). Examples: «haz un backup de documentos», «respalda el escritorio», «backup de mis fotos».
tools.backup.known.list: List the ZIP backups of known folders and re-verify that they are intact. Use when: asking which folder backups exist. Do not use when: backups of single files (use backup.list). Examples: «¿qué respaldos de carpetas tengo?», «muéstrame los backups de documentos», «lista mis copias de seguridad de carpetas».
tools.backup.known.restore.latest: Restore the most recent ZIP backup of a known folder by extracting it into a new separate folder; the original is not overwritten. Use when: recuperar or restaurar a folder backup. Do not use when: only checking integrity (use backup.known.verify.latest), a single-file backup (use backup.restore). Examples: «restaura el último backup de documentos», «recupera el respaldo del escritorio», «restore my pictures backup».
tools.backup.known.verify.latest: Check that the most recent ZIP backup of a known folder is intact (SHA-256), without restoring it. Use when: asking whether a folder backup is OK. Do not use when: restoring it (use backup.known.restore.latest), a single-file backup (use backup.verify). Examples: «verifica el último respaldo de documentos», «¿está bien el backup del escritorio?», «chequea el backup de fotos».
tools.backup.list: List the private backups of single files, newest first. Use when: asking about backups of individual files. Do not use when: ZIP backups of whole folders (use backup.known.list). Examples: «¿qué archivos tengo respaldados?», «lista los respaldos de archivos», «muéstrame las copias de archivos sueltos».
tools.backup.restore: Restore a single-file backup into a free path of BAXY's private work folder (sandbox). Use when: recovering a file backup listed earlier. Do not use when: a folder ZIP backup (use backup.known.restore.latest), a file BAXY deleted to its private trash (use filesystem.trash.restore). Examples: «restaura ese respaldo», «recupera la copia del informe», «restore that backup».
tools.backup.verify: Check that a private single-file backup is intact (size and SHA-256), without restoring it. Use when: asking whether one file backup is OK. Do not use when: a folder ZIP backup (use backup.known.verify.latest), restoring it (use backup.restore). Examples: «verifica ese respaldo», «¿está intacta la copia del informe?», «check that backup».
tools.bluetooth.device.list: List the available Bluetooth devices, without connecting any. Use when: asking which Bluetooth devices are around. Do not use when: pairing one (use bluetooth.device.pair), asking whether Bluetooth is on (use bluetooth.radio.status), wired peripherals (use peripheral.list). Examples: «¿qué dispositivos bluetooth hay?», «busca audífonos bluetooth», «lista los bluetooth».
tools.bluetooth.device.pair: Pair an already identified Bluetooth device through Windows' own pairing dialog and permission. Use when: emparejar, vincular or conectar a Bluetooth device. Do not use when: only listing devices (use bluetooth.device.list), turning Bluetooth on (use bluetooth.radio.set). Examples: «empareja mis audífonos», «vincula el parlante bluetooth», «pair the jbl».
tools.bluetooth.radio.set: Turn the PC's Bluetooth radio on or off. Use when: prende/apaga/activa/desactiva el bluetooth. Do not use when: only asking its state (use bluetooth.radio.status), Wi-Fi (use wifi.radio.set), airplane mode for all radios (use system.settings.set). Examples: «prende el bluetooth», «apaga el bluetooth», «turn on bluetooth».
tools.bluetooth.radio.status: Read whether Bluetooth is on or off, without changing it. Use when: asking about the Bluetooth state. Do not use when: switching it (use bluetooth.radio.set), listing devices (use bluetooth.device.list). Examples: «¿está prendido el bluetooth?», «¿tengo el bluetooth activado?», «¿el bluetooth está on?».
tools.browser.control: Act on the open web page: back, reload, scroll up or down, new tab, fullscreen video, close the page or all pages. Use when: the person refers to the current page. Do not use when: a new address (use browser.navigate), scrolling a non-browser window (use input.pointer.control), closing another app (use app.close). Examples: «vuelve atrás», «baja en la página», «recarga la página».
tools.browser.navigate: Go to an exact web address in the person's browser; also open a search-results page there when the engine or browser is named as the place («búscalo en Google»). Use when: a URL or site is given. Do not use when: a browser is named (use browser.navigate.named), an answer is wanted (use web.search), a YouTube video should play (use media.play.youtube). Examples: «abre youtube.com», «ve a wikipedia.org», «búscalo en google». Never use it to reach a section of a desktop application that is open on screen (a library, a tab, a settings page): that is input.visible.click on its label.
tools.browser.navigate.named: Open a web address in a named browser: Opera, Opera GX, Chrome, Edge or Brave. Use when: the person names one of those browsers as where the page opens. Do not use when: no browser is named (use browser.navigate), only the browser app is wanted with no page (use app.open). Examples: «abre youtube en opera gx», «abre gmail en chrome», «open netflix.com en edge».
tools.browser.page.read: Read the title, address and visible text of the open web page, without touching it. Use when: asking what the current page says or to summarize it. Do not use when: a PDF or text file (use file.read), searching the internet (use web.search), listing tabs (use browser.tabs.list). Examples: «¿qué dice esta página?», «resúmeme la página», «lee la web abierta».
tools.browser.tabs.list: List the tabs open in the browser, with title and address. Use when: asking which tabs or pestañas are open. Do not use when: reading one page's text (use browser.page.read), asking which app window is in front (use window.active). Examples: «¿qué pestañas tengo abiertas?», «lista las pestañas», «muéstrame los tabs».
tools.calculator.expression.evaluate: Type a simple arithmetic expression into the open Windows Calculator and read the result it displays. Use when: the person asks to compute something in the Calculator. Do not use when: the Calculator should only be opened (use app.open). Examples: «calcula 25 por 4 en la calculadora», «haz 120 dividido 3», «suma 15 más 27». Only when the person explicitly asks to use the Calculator app; a plain arithmetic question is answered directly in text, without tools.
tools.calendar.event.create: Create an event in the account calendar with a title, start time and end time. Use when: agendar a meeting or appointment with a time span. Do not use when: something must ring or remind at a time (use schedule.alarms), a to-do (use task.create). Examples: «agenda una reunión mañana de 3 a 4», «crea un evento el viernes de 10 a 11», «dentista en el calendario el lunes de 9 a 10».
tools.calendar.event.list: List the calendar events between two dates or times, without changing them. Use when: asking what is on the calendar or agenda. Do not use when: alarms or reminders (use schedule.alarms), tasks (use task.list). Examples: «¿qué tengo en el calendario mañana?», «muéstrame mis eventos de esta semana», «¿tengo reuniones hoy?».
tools.capture.active.window: Take a screenshot of only the active window; optionally also save it as PNG in a known folder. Use when: the capture is of this window or the current app. Do not use when: the whole desktop (use capture.screenshot), reading or describing the screen (use ocr.read or vision.describe after a capture). Examples: «captura la ventana activa», «sácale foto a esta ventana», «screenshot de esta ventana».
tools.capture.screenshot: Take a screenshot of the whole desktop; optionally also save it as PNG in a known folder (desktop, documents, downloads, pictures). Use when: captura de pantalla, pantallazo or screenshot without limiting it to one window. Do not use when: only the active window (use capture.active.window). Examples: «toma una captura de pantalla», «saca un pantallazo y guárdalo en el escritorio», «haz un screenshot».
tools.client.channel.locate: Search Discord's quick switcher for a channel or chat by name and say whether it appears, joining or opening nothing. Use when: whether a Discord channel or chat exists. Do not use when: writing a message (use message.draft), opening Discord (use app.open). Examples: «busca el canal general en discord», «¿está el canal de música en discord?», «find the memes channel en discord».
tools.clipboard.copy: Copy what is selected in the active window, like Ctrl+C. Use when: copia esto or copy the selection. Do not use when: putting a given text in the clipboard (use clipboard.write.text), reading what was copied (use clipboard.read.text), selecting first (use input.select.all). Examples: «copia lo seleccionado», «cópialo», «copy this».
tools.clipboard.paste: Paste the clipboard contents where the cursor is, like Ctrl+V. Use when: pega or paste. Do not use when: typing a given text (use input.text.type), reading the clipboard aloud (use clipboard.read.text). Examples: «pega aquí», «pégalo», «paste it».
tools.clipboard.read.text: Read the text currently in the clipboard, without changing it. Use when: asking what was copied. Do not use when: pasting it somewhere (use clipboard.paste), copying the selection (use clipboard.copy). Examples: «¿qué tengo copiado?», «lee el portapapeles», «what's in my clipboard?».
tools.clipboard.write.text: Put a given text into the clipboard for later pasting, without copying anything from the screen. Use when: the person dictates the text to place in the clipboard. Do not use when: copying the on-screen selection (use clipboard.copy), typing the text directly (use input.text.type). Examples: «copia al portapapeles hola mundo», «pon en el portapapeles 'nos vemos a las 8'», «guarda 'listo' en el clipboard».
tools.desktop.wallpaper.set: Change the desktop wallpaper to a named solid color or to an image from a known folder (desktop, documents, downloads, pictures). Use when: cambia el fondo de pantalla or wallpaper. Do not use when: brightness or night light (use system.settings.set). Examples: «cambia el fondo de pantalla a azul», «pon de fondo playa.jpg de imágenes», «cambia el wallpaper a negro».
tools.display.status: Read which monitors are connected and their resolution and refresh rate, without changing anything. Use when: asking about monitors, resolution or Hz. Do not use when: brightness (use system.settings.status), general PC specs (use system.status). Examples: «¿cuántos monitores tengo?», «¿qué resolución tiene la pantalla?», «¿a cuántos hz está el monitor?».
tools.document.presentation.create: Create a PowerPoint (.pptx) with a title and slides (first line the slide title, the rest bullets) in a known folder. Use when: hazme un powerpoint or una presentación. Do not use when: Word or Excel (use office.document.create), a plain text file (use file.write). Examples: «haz un powerpoint de 5 diapositivas sobre el reciclaje», «crea una presentación sobre Chile», «make a ppt de marketing».
tools.email.latest.read: Read the most recent email received in Outlook. Use when: asking for the last or newest email. Do not use when: replying to it (use email.latest.reply), writing a new email (use email.send). Examples: «lee mi último correo», «¿qué dice el último mail?», «read my latest email».
tools.email.latest.reply: Reply with a given text to the most recent email received in Outlook. Use when: respóndele or contéstale al último correo. Do not use when: a new email to an address (use email.send), only reading it (use email.latest.read). Examples: «responde al último correo que llego tarde», «contéstale al último mail: gracias», «reply ok al último email».
tools.email.send: Send a new email to an address, with an optional subject, from the owner's Outlook. Use when: a correo or mail to a given address with its text. Do not use when: replying to the last email (use email.latest.reply), WhatsApp or Discord (use message.draft), a test send (use message.send.test). Examples: «manda un correo a juan@gmail.com que mañana no voy», «envía un mail a ana@empresa.cl con asunto reunión», «send an email a pedro@mail.com: listo».
tools.file.compress: Compress a file or folder from a known folder into a ZIP with the same name next to it. Use when: comprimir or zipear. Do not use when: a verified backup of a whole known folder (use backup.known.create). Examples: «comprime la carpeta fotos del escritorio», «haz un zip de informe.docx en documentos», «zipea proyecto en descargas».
tools.file.edit: Replace an exact piece of text with another in a text file of a known folder (Desktop, Documents, Downloads), by the file's name or the relativePath file.find gave; the previous version goes to the Recycle Bin. oldText must appear exactly once unless replaceAll is true: copy it exactly as file.read showed it. Use when: cambia X por Y en un archivo, corrige una línea or a word inside a file. Do not use when: writing the whole content (use file.write), adding at the end (use file.write with append), a note (use note.update). Examples: «en notas.txt cambia lunes por martes», «corrige 'hloa' por 'hola' en el readme.md», «reemplaza todas las veces 2024 por 2025 en informe.md».
tools.file.find: List the top level of a known folder (Desktop, Documents, Downloads, or all), or find files under it by name (part of the name, or a pattern like *.pdf) or by a text inside its text files; order recent puts the newest first, and each file comes with its relativePath. Use when: qué hay en a folder, busca el archivo X, dónde está mi X, which file mentions X. Do not use when: BAXY's private work folder (use filesystem.list or filesystem.search), reading a file (use file.read), notes (use note.search), the internet (use web.search). Examples: «¿qué hay en el escritorio?», «busca el archivo presupuesto», «¿qué archivo de documentos habla de la reunión con Juan?».
tools.file.open: Open a specific file by its name from a known folder with its default app or a named installed app. Use when: abre el archivo X. Do not use when: the newest unnamed file (use filesystem.file.open.latest), a folder (use filesystem.folder.open), an application (use app.open), reading without showing (use file.read). Examples: «abre tarea.docx del escritorio», «abre foto.png de descargas con paint», «open informe.pdf». Set foreground true so the person sees the file.
tools.file.read: Read the text of a file by its name (or the relativePath file.find gave) from a known folder: a text or code file (txt, md, json, code) or a PDF (its own text, no OCR), without opening it on screen. A long file comes in pages: when hasMore is true, call again with offset set to nextOffset. Use when: qué dice, resume or lee a named file. Do not use when: showing it on screen (use file.open), a file in BAXY's private work folder (use filesystem.read.text), the open web page (use browser.page.read), a Word or Excel document BAXY created (use office.document.read). Examples: «resume el pdf contrato.pdf», «¿de qué trata el roadmap.md?», «léeme notas.txt del escritorio».
tools.file.write: Write text to a file in Desktop, Documents, Downloads or BAXY's work folder: create it, replace an existing one (pass expectedSha256, the fileSha256 file.read gave; its previous version goes to the Recycle Bin), or with append true add the text at the end, keeping what is there. Use when: crea un archivo de texto, escribe X en un archivo, agrega una línea al final de un archivo. Do not use when: changing only part of a file (use file.edit), a note (use note.create), Word or Excel (use office.document.create), a PowerPoint (use document.presentation.create). Examples: «crea hola.txt en el escritorio que diga hola», «agrega 'comprar pan' al final de lista.txt», «save this en notas.txt».
tools.filesystem.copy: Copy an already identified file to another path inside BAXY's private work folder, verifying its hash. Use when: copying a sandbox file BAXY listed earlier. Do not use when: a backup (use backup.create), files in Desktop, Documents or Downloads (sandbox only). Examples: «copia ese archivo a la carpeta respaldo», «duplica notas.txt en tu carpeta de trabajo», «copy it to otra carpeta».
tools.filesystem.create.directory: Create a new folder in Desktop, Documents, Downloads or BAXY's private work folder. Use when: crea una carpeta. Do not use when: opening an existing folder (use filesystem.folder.open), creating a file (use file.write). Examples: «crea una carpeta proyectos en el escritorio», «haz una carpeta nueva llamada fotos en documentos», «make a folder tareas en descargas».
tools.filesystem.explorer.count: Count how many files with an extension are in the folder shown by the front File Explorer window, or on the Desktop if none is in front. Use when: cuántos archivos .X hay. Do not use when: listing or searching files (use file.find). Examples: «¿cuántos archivos .py hay en esta carpeta?», «cuenta los pdf del escritorio», «how many jpg hay aquí?».
tools.filesystem.file.open.latest: Open the most recently modified file of a known folder, without the person naming it. Use when: lo último que descargué or el archivo más reciente. Do not use when: the file is named (use file.open), opening the folder itself (use filesystem.folder.open). Examples: «abre el último archivo de descargas», «abre lo último que bajé», «open the newest file en documentos».
tools.filesystem.folder.open: Open a known Windows folder (Desktop, Documents, Downloads, Pictures) in File Explorer. Use when: abre la carpeta de descargas or documentos. Do not use when: saying its contents aloud (use file.find), opening a file (use file.open), creating a folder (use filesystem.create.directory). Examples: «abre descargas», «ábreme la carpeta documentos», «open my pictures folder».
tools.filesystem.known.duplicates: Find duplicate files in Downloads (same size and SHA-256), without deleting or changing anything. Use when: archivos repetidos or duplicados. Do not use when: deleting a file (use filesystem.known.trash.named), comparing two text files line by line (use filesystem.sandbox.diff.named). Examples: «busca archivos duplicados en descargas», «¿tengo archivos repetidos?», «find duplicates en downloads».
tools.filesystem.known.trash.named: Delete a file by its name from a known folder by moving it to BAXY's private recoverable trash, after confirmation. Use when: borra or elimina the file X. Do not use when: emptying the Windows Recycle Bin (use system.recyclebin.empty), a note or task (use note.trash or task.delete), an alarm or reminder (use schedule.alarms), undoing a deletion (use filesystem.trash.restore). Examples: «borra viejo.txt del escritorio», «elimina foto1.png de descargas», «delete tarea.docx».
tools.filesystem.list: List what is in BAXY's private work folder (sandbox), not the user's folders. Use when: the person refers to BAXY's own work folder. Do not use when: Desktop, Documents or Downloads (use file.find). Examples: «¿qué hay en tu carpeta de trabajo?», «lista tus archivos de trabajo», «muéstrame el sandbox».
tools.filesystem.move: Move an already identified file to another path inside BAXY's private work folder, verifying its hash. Use when: moving a work-folder file BAXY listed earlier. Do not use when: the file is only known by its name (use filesystem.sandbox.move.named). Examples: «mueve ese archivo a la carpeta viejos», «pásalo a la subcarpeta 2025», «move it to archivo».
tools.filesystem.read.text: Read the text of an already identified file in BAXY's private work folder. Use when: reading a work-folder file BAXY listed earlier. Do not use when: a text file or PDF in the user's known folders (use file.read). Examples: «lee ese archivo», «¿qué dice ese txt de tu carpeta?», «read that file».
tools.filesystem.sandbox.diff.named: Compare two text files in BAXY's private work folder by name and say which lines differ. Use when: compara a con b or en qué se diferencian. Do not use when: finding duplicate files (use filesystem.known.duplicates). Examples: «compara version1.txt con version2.txt», «¿qué cambia entre notas y notas_viejas?», «diff de config.json y config2.json».
tools.filesystem.sandbox.move.named: Move a file by its name to another path inside BAXY's private work folder. Use when: moving a work-folder file the person names. Do not use when: the file was already identified by id (use filesystem.move). Examples: «mueve informe.txt a la carpeta archivo», «pasa notas.txt a viejos», «move log.txt to backup».
tools.filesystem.search: Search files by name in BAXY's private work folder (sandbox), not the user's folders. Use when: searching BAXY's own work folder. Do not use when: Desktop, Documents or Downloads (use file.find). Examples: «busca informe en tu carpeta de trabajo», «¿tienes algún archivo log en tu carpeta?», «search notas en tu workspace».
tools.filesystem.trash.restore: Restore a file BAXY deleted, from BAXY's private trash back to its original place. Use when: recupera el archivo que borraste or undo a deletion. Do not use when: restoring a backup (use backup.restore or backup.known.restore.latest), a note or task (use note.restore or task.restore). Examples: «recupera el archivo que borraste», «devuelve viejo.txt», «undo the delete».
tools.game.catalog.list: List the games in the local Steam library, optionally filtered by text. Use when: qué juegos tengo. Do not use when: one game's ownership or install state (use game.entitlement.named or game.installed.named), playing (use game.launch). Examples: «¿qué juegos tengo en steam?», «lista mis juegos», «muéstrame mi biblioteca de steam».
tools.game.entitlement.named: Check whether a Steam or Epic game is in the person's library and whether it is installed, without downloading or opening anything. Use when: do I own it or is it in my library. Do not use when: only installed-on-disk (use game.installed.named), downloading (use game.install.named), playing (use game.launch), opening Steam itself (use app.open). Examples: «¿tengo el hollow knight en steam?», «¿está fall guys en mi biblioteca de epic?», «do I own portal 2?».
tools.game.install.cancel: Cancel the partial download of one specific Steam game. Use when: cancela or para la descarga of a named game. Do not use when: canceling every download (use game.install.cancel.active), uninstalling (use game.uninstall.named). Examples: «cancela la descarga de dota», «para de bajar el cs2», «stop downloading terraria».
tools.game.install.cancel.active: Cancel all game downloads Steam has in progress. Use when: cancel downloads with no game named, or all of them. Do not use when: one specific game is named (use game.install.cancel). Examples: «cancela todas las descargas de steam», «para las descargas», «stop all steam downloads».
tools.game.install.named: Download and install a Steam or Epic game by its title, if it is in the library. Use when: descarga or instala a game. Do not use when: only asking whether it is installed or owned (use game.installed.named or game.entitlement.named), checking progress (use game.install.status), a normal program that is not a game. Examples: «descarga el hollow knight», «instala fall guys en epic», «install terraria de steam».
tools.game.install.status: Check how the download or installation of an already identified Steam game is going. Use when: cómo va or cuánto le falta a una descarga. Do not use when: asking whether it is installed (use game.installed.named), starting a download (use game.install.named). Examples: «¿cómo va la descarga de dota?», «¿cuánto le falta al cs2?», «install progress de terraria». Only while a download or install is in progress; whether a game is installed or downloaded at all is game.installed.named.
tools.game.installed.named: Answer only whether a Steam or Epic game is installed on this PC, by name, without opening it. Use when: the request is a question («¿está instalado X?»). Do not use when: abre/juega/lanza (use game.launch for a game; «abre steam» is app.open), library ownership (use game.entitlement.named), normal apps (use app.installed). Examples: «¿tengo instalado el minecraft?», «¿está instalado el gta v?», «is rocket league installed?». Only for yes/no questions about installation; a request to play or open the game is game.launch.
tools.game.launch: Launch (play) a Steam game the person owns. Use when: juega, abre or lanza a specific game title. Do not use when: opening Steam, Epic or any normal application (use app.open), only asking whether it is installed (use game.installed.named). Examples: «abre el hollow knight», «quiero jugar terraria», «lanza el cs2». appId must be the appId of one game in the person's library list below; never invent an id. A wish to play a game the person names is a launch, not an installed-check.
tools.game.uninstall.named: Uninstall an installed Steam game by its title, after confirmation. Use when: desinstala a game. Do not use when: a normal program (use package.uninstall), canceling a download (use game.install.cancel). Examples: «desinstala worms rumble», «borra el dota de steam», «uninstall terraria».
tools.input.key.press: Press one key or safe shortcut in the active window (Enter, Escape, Tab, arrows, Ctrl+S/Z/F/T/W, Alt+Tab, F5, Ctrl+Shift+Esc). Use when: a key or shortcut is named. Do not use when: typing text (use input.text.type), select all (use input.select.all), copy or paste (use clipboard.copy or clipboard.paste), clicking a button (use input.visible.click). Examples: «presiona enter», «aprieta escape», «dale ctrl z».
tools.input.keyboard.layout: Switch the keyboard input language of the active window to Spanish. Use when: pon el teclado en español. Do not use when: only asking which language it is (use input.keyboard.status), the on-screen keyboard (use input.keyboard.open). Examples: «cambia el teclado a español», «pon el teclado en español», «teclado in spanish please».
tools.input.keyboard.open: Open the Windows on-screen keyboard. Use when: teclado en pantalla or teclado virtual. Do not use when: changing the keyboard language (use input.keyboard.layout), typing text (use input.text.type). Examples: «abre el teclado en pantalla», «muéstrame el teclado virtual», «open on-screen keyboard».
tools.input.keyboard.status: Read the input language of the active window's keyboard, without changing it. Use when: en qué idioma está el teclado. Do not use when: changing it (use input.keyboard.layout). Examples: «¿en qué idioma está el teclado?», «¿el teclado está en inglés?», «keyboard layout actual?».
tools.input.pointer.control: Move the mouse pointer to the screen center, click where it is, or scroll down. Use when: a raw mouse action with no target named. Do not use when: clicking a named button or option (use input.visible.click), scrolling a web page (use browser.control). Examples: «haz clic», «mueve el mouse al centro», «scrollea hacia abajo».
tools.input.select.all: Select everything in the focused control of the active window, like Ctrl+A. Use when: selecciona todo. Do not use when: copying (use clipboard.copy; select and copy are separate steps). Examples: «selecciona todo», «marca todo el texto», «select all».
tools.input.text.type: Type a given literal text where the cursor is, in the active window. Use when: escribe or tipea a stated text. Do not use when: pasting the clipboard (use clipboard.paste), a chat message to someone (use message.draft), writing a file (use file.write), pressing a key (use input.key.press). Examples: «escribe hola mundo», «tipea buenos días», «escribe mi correo: ana@gmail.com».
tools.input.visible.click: Click a control or a text you saw in your last look at the window (input.visible.controls), by its label, adding its index when the look gave one. Use when: going to a section, tab or menu of an open app, or pressing a button there. Do not use when: you have not looked at the window yet (look first), a raw click where the pointer is (use input.pointer.control), going to a web address (use browser.navigate). Examples: «haz clic en aceptar», «pulsa guardar», «entra a la biblioteca» (after looking at Steam).
tools.input.visible.controls: Look at an application window: returns its visible controls (index, kind, name, state) and the text on screen. Use when: you must act inside an open app or read what it shows — before clicking, typing or answering about it — or the person asks what is on screen; set application to the app's name (for example right after opening it). Do not use when: the text of a web page is wanted (use browser.page.read). Examples: «ve a la biblioteca de steam» (look at Steam, then click «BIBLIOTECA»), «¿qué marca la calculadora?», «¿qué botones hay?».
tools.media.control: Pause, play, resume, stop, skip to next or go back to previous on what is already playing. Use when: pausa, siguiente, anterior or dale play without naming new content. Do not use when: playing something new by name (use media.play.query, media.play.exact, media.play.youtube or streaming.play.named), seeking seconds (use media.seek.relative), muting (use audio.mute). Examples: «pausa la música», «siguiente canción», «dale play».
tools.media.play.exact: Play one exact song by its title on Spotify, not just open the app. Use when: a precise song title is given. Do not use when: an artist, genre or loose search (use media.play.query), YouTube or a video (use media.play.youtube), a movie or series (use streaming.play.named), only opening Spotify (use app.open). Examples: «pon la canción Bohemian Rhapsody», «reproduce Despacito exacta en spotify», «play the song Yellow».
tools.media.play.query: Search music on Spotify (song, artist or style) and play the first result. Use when: pon música de X or algo de un estilo. Do not use when: one exact song title (use media.play.exact), YouTube or a video (use media.play.youtube), a movie or series (use streaming.play.named), resuming (use media.control), only opening Spotify (use app.open). Examples: «pon música de bad bunny», «ponme algo de rock en spotify», «play some lofi».
tools.media.play.youtube: Search a video on YouTube and play it. Use when: YouTube is named or a video is wanted. Do not use when: music on Spotify (use media.play.query or media.play.exact), Netflix, Disney+ or HBO Max titles (use streaming.play.named), only opening youtube.com (use browser.navigate). Examples: «pon un video de gatos en youtube», «ponme el tráiler de dune en youtube», «play lofi en youtube».
tools.media.seek.relative: Skip forward or back a number of seconds in what is playing. Use when: adelanta or retrocede N segundos. Do not use when: next or previous track (use media.control). Examples: «adelanta 30 segundos», «retrocede 10 segundos», «skip 1 minute».
tools.media.status: Read what is playing now: title, artist and whether it is paused, without changing anything. Use when: qué canción es or qué está sonando. Do not use when: the volume (use audio.status). Examples: «¿qué canción está sonando?», «¿cómo se llama esta canción?», «what's playing?».
tools.memory.correct: Correct a fact BAXY already remembers, replacing its value with a new one. Use when: the person fixes a remembered datum. Do not use when: saving a new fact (use memory.save), forgetting it (use memory.forget). Examples: «corrige: mi color favorito es el verde», «no, mi perro se llama Toby, no Tobi», «actualiza mi equipo favorito a Colo-Colo».
tools.memory.disable: Turn BAXY's memory off so it stops saving and reading facts. Use when: desactiva la memoria or deja de recordar. Do not use when: forgetting specific data (use memory.forget), clearing only this conversation (use memory.session.clear). Examples: «desactiva tu memoria», «deja de recordar cosas», «turn off memory».
tools.memory.enable: Turn BAXY's private memory on, with confirmation. Use when: activa la memoria. Do not use when: only asking whether it is on (use memory.status). Examples: «activa tu memoria», «vuelve a recordar cosas», «enable memory».
tools.memory.export: Prepare a private export of what BAXY remembers into Documents, without secret data. Use when: exporta or saca una copia de la memoria. Do not use when: just listing it (use memory.list). Examples: «exporta lo que recuerdas», «sácame una copia de tu memoria», «export memory».
tools.memory.forget: Make BAXY forget remembered facts (one fact, a topic, a kind or all), after confirming what is deleted. Use when: olvida X or borra lo que sabes de X. Do not use when: only this conversation (use memory.session.clear), turning memory off (use memory.disable), changing a value (use memory.correct). Examples: «olvida mi dirección», «borra todo lo que recuerdas», «forget my birthday».
tools.memory.list: List everything BAXY remembers. Use when: a general question about all remembered facts. Do not use when: one concrete thing (use memory.recall), notes (use note.list). Examples: «¿qué cosas recuerdas?», «lista tu memoria», «what do you remember?».
tools.memory.recall: Ask BAXY what it remembers about one concrete thing. Use when: cuál es mi X or te acuerdas de X. Do not use when: everything remembered (use memory.list), searching notes (use note.search). Examples: «¿cuál es mi color favorito?», «¿te acuerdas de mi cumpleaños?», «¿qué recuerdas de mi perro?».
tools.memory.save: Ask BAXY to remember a fact, preference or rule that is not sensitive. Use when: recuerda que or acuérdate de que. Do not use when: sensitive or secret data (use memory.sensitive.save), it must ring or remind at a time (use schedule.alarms), a note (use note.create), a to-do (use task.create). Examples: «recuerda que mi color favorito es el azul», «acuérdate de que prefiero respuestas cortas», «remember que mi perro se llama Toby».
tools.memory.sensitive.save: Ask BAXY to remember a sensitive or secret datum (health, ID numbers, keys), after confirmation. Use when: the fact to remember is sensitive. Do not use when: an ordinary fact or preference (use memory.save). Examples: «recuerda mi RUT 12.345.678-9», «guarda que soy alérgico a la penicilina», «remember mi clave del wifi».
tools.memory.session.clear: Delete only what was remembered in this conversation, keeping permanent memory. Use when: olvida lo de esta conversación. Do not use when: forgetting permanent facts (use memory.forget). Examples: «olvida lo que hablamos ahora», «borra la memoria de esta sesión», «clear this session».
tools.memory.status: Report whether BAXY's memory is on and what its limits are. Use when: asking if memory is active. Do not use when: listing remembered facts (use memory.list). Examples: «¿está activa tu memoria?», «¿puedes recordar cosas?», «memory status».
tools.message.draft: Leave a message written for someone in WhatsApp or Discord without sending it; the person sends it. Use when: escríbele or mándale un mensaje a X. Do not use when: an email (use email.send), a test send (use message.send.test), an already resolved recipient id (use message.send). Examples: «escríbele a mamá por whatsapp que llego a las 8», «mándale a Pedro en discord que se conecte», «dile a Ana por wsp hola». The recipient is the contact name exactly as the person says it (a name or a family word); never ask for a phone number.
tools.message.send: Send a message to an already identified contact (resolved recipient id) and verify it was delivered. Use when: the recipient was resolved earlier and the person confirms sending. Do not use when: the contact is only named (use message.draft), an email (use email.send). Examples: «envíaselo», «sí, mándalo», «send it».
tools.message.send.test: Really send a test message or email, always forced to the owner's test channel, never to the person named. Use when: a mensaje or correo de prueba is asked for. Do not use when: a normal message to a contact (use message.draft), a normal email (use email.send). Examples: «manda un mensaje de prueba por whatsapp», «envía un correo de prueba», «test message en discord».
tools.network.dns.status: Read which DNS servers the PC's connection uses. Use when: qué DNS uso. Do not use when: IP addresses (use network.ip.list), general connectivity (use network.status). Examples: «¿qué dns tengo?», «muéstrame los servidores dns», «dns actuales?».
tools.network.ip.list: List this PC's own IP addresses. Use when: cuál es mi IP. Do not use when: DNS servers (use network.dns.status), testing another host (use network.ping). Examples: «¿cuál es mi ip?», «dime mis direcciones ip», «what's my ip».
tools.network.ping: Ping a host or address once and say whether it answers and how long it takes. Use when: haz ping or responde X. Do not use when: general internet connectivity (use network.status). Examples: «haz ping a google.com», «¿responde 8.8.8.8?», «ping a cloudflare».
tools.network.port.list: List the PC's open listening TCP and UDP ports. Use when: qué puertos están abiertos. Do not use when: running programs (use system.process.list). Examples: «¿qué puertos tengo abiertos?», «lista los puertos en escucha», «open ports?».
tools.network.status: Check whether there is internet connectivity and which network connections are active. Use when: tengo internet. Do not use when: Wi-Fi specifically (use wifi.status), pinging a host (use network.ping). Examples: «¿tengo internet?», «¿estoy conectado a la red?», «network status».
tools.note.create: Create a private note with a title and free-text content. Use when: crea una nota or toma nota. Do not use when: a to-do or list item (use task.create), something that rings or reminds at a time (use schedule.alarms), a fact for BAXY to remember (use memory.save), a text file (use file.write). Examples: «crea una nota que diga comprar pan», «toma nota: ideas para la tesis», «haz una nota reunión con Juan».
tools.note.list: List the notes, active or in the trash. Use when: qué notas tengo. Do not use when: searching inside notes (use note.search), tasks (use task.list). Examples: «¿qué notas tengo?», «muéstrame las notas borradas», «list my notes».
tools.note.read: Read one note by its title. Use when: lee la nota X. Do not use when: searching notes by text (use note.search). Examples: «lee la nota ideas», «¿qué dice la nota de compras?», «read note tesis».
tools.note.restore: Restore a deleted note from the trash, by its title. Use when: recupera la nota X. Do not use when: a file (use filesystem.trash.restore), a task (use task.restore). Examples: «recupera la nota ideas», «restaura la nota que borré», «undelete note compras».
tools.note.search: Search the notes that contain a text. Use when: busca en mis notas. Do not use when: files (use file.find), tasks (use task.search), the internet (use web.search). Examples: «busca en mis notas la palabra tesis», «¿en qué nota puse el teléfono de Juan?», «search notes for receta».
tools.note.trash: Delete a note by its title, moving it to a recoverable trash. Use when: borra la nota X. Do not use when: a task (use task.delete), a file (use filesystem.known.trash.named). Examples: «borra la nota ideas», «elimina la nota de compras», «delete note tesis».
tools.note.update: Change the title or the content of an existing note. Use when: cambia or edita la nota X. Do not use when: a new note (use note.create), a task (use task.update). Examples: «cambia la nota ideas a 'llamar al profe'», «edita la nota compras: leche y pan», «renombra la nota tesis a proyecto».
tools.ocr.read: Read the text that appears in a screenshot already taken (by its capture id). Use when: the text on screen or in a capture is wanted. Do not use when: describing what is seen (use vision.describe), the open web page (use browser.page.read), no capture yet (use capture.screenshot first). Examples: «lee el texto de la captura», «¿qué dice en la pantalla?», «haz OCR de la captura».
tools.office.document.create: Create a new Office document, Word (.docx) or Excel (.xlsx), with a title. Use when: crea un documento de Word or una planilla Excel. Do not use when: a PowerPoint (use document.presentation.create), a plain text file (use file.write). Examples: «crea un documento de word llamado informe», «haz una planilla excel de gastos», «new word doc tesis».
tools.office.document.read: Read the content of an already identified Office document. Use when: reading a document created or identified earlier. Do not use when: a PDF or a text file (use file.read). Examples: «lee ese documento», «¿qué dice el word que creaste?», «read that doc».
tools.package.uninstall: Uninstall a normal program from the PC by its name and verify it is gone, after confirmation. Use when: desinstala a program. Do not use when: a Steam game (use game.uninstall.named), closing it (use app.close). Examples: «desinstala discord», «quita el zoom del pc», «uninstall vlc».
tools.peripheral.list: List connected peripherals (mouse, keyboard, printer, scanner, USB), optionally of one kind. Use when: qué periféricos hay or is a mouse or printer connected. Do not use when: USB drives and free space (use storage.removable.list), Bluetooth devices (use bluetooth.device.list), monitors (use display.status). Examples: «¿qué periféricos hay conectados?», «¿hay una impresora conectada?», «lista los dispositivos usb».
tools.peripheral.print: Print an already identified document on a printer. Use when: imprime. Do not use when: listing printers (use peripheral.list). Examples: «imprime ese documento», «mándalo a la impresora», «print it».
tools.peripheral.scan: Scan a document with a scanner. Use when: escanea. Do not use when: a screenshot (use capture.screenshot), reading text from a capture (use ocr.read). Examples: «escanea este documento», «usa el escáner», «scan a page».
tools.routine.delete: Delete a chosen routine, recoverably, without running it. Use when: borra la rutina X. Do not use when: only turning it off (use routine.set.enabled). Examples: «borra la rutina foto», «elimina esa rutina», «delete routine estudiar».
tools.routine.list: List the routines that were created. Use when: qué rutinas tengo. Do not use when: one routine's details (use routine.read). Examples: «¿qué rutinas tengo?», «lista mis rutinas», «show routines».
tools.routine.phrase.create: Create a routine that controls playback or takes a screenshot when BAXY hears an exact phrase. Use when: cuando diga X, haz Y. Do not use when: something at a time (use schedule.alarms), doing it now (use media.control or capture.screenshot). Examples: «crea una rutina: cuando diga 'a estudiar' pausa la música», «cuando diga 'foto' saca una captura», «make a routine: al decir 'silencio' pausa».
tools.routine.read: Show one routine's details without running it. Use when: qué hace la rutina X. Do not use when: listing all routines (use routine.list). Examples: «¿qué hace la rutina foto?», «muéstrame la rutina estudiar», «read routine silencio».
tools.routine.restore: Restore a deleted routine; it comes back disabled and does not run. Use when: recupera la rutina X. Do not use when: enabling a routine that was only disabled (use routine.set.enabled). Examples: «recupera la rutina foto», «restaura la rutina que borré», «undelete routine estudiar».
tools.routine.set.enabled: Enable or disable a routine, without running it. Use when: activa or desactiva la rutina X. Do not use when: deleting it (use routine.delete). Examples: «desactiva la rutina foto», «activa la rutina estudiar», «turn off routine silencio».
tools.schedule.alarms: Set, list or cancel BAXY's alarms and reminders, which ring on this PC (Windows Task Scheduler), or check why one did not ring. Use when: an alarm, a timer, a wake-up or a reminder at a time or in some minutes, which ones are set, or cancelling one. Do not use when: a to-do without a time (use task.create), a calendar event (use calendar.event.create), a note (use note.create). How to fill it: action create needs title and either inMinutes (minutes from now), inSeconds (seconds, for a short timer) or at (the local time in 24 hours, HH:mm, or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm for another day); kind alarm for alarms and wake-ups, reminder otherwise; recurrence daily or hourly only when it repeats. action cancel with at cancels the one at that local time, without at the latest. Examples: «recuérdame en 20 minutos sacar la ropa» (create, inMinutes 20), «despiértame mañana a las 7» (create, alarm, at 07:00), «qué alarmas tengo» (list), «cancela la alarma de las 7» (cancel, at 07:00).
tools.shell.command.run: Run a PowerShell console command (in a known folder or a private empty one) and return its output; a command that does more than read (writes, deletes, installs, sends, runs a program) waits for the person's yes. Use when: ejecuta or corre a command. Do not use when: a dedicated operation exists (system.process.list, network.ping, app.open). Examples: «ejecuta ls en el escritorio», «corre pytest en documentos/proyecto», «run git status».
tools.software.python.package.status: Check whether a Python package is installed, and its version, in each registered Python, without installing anything. Use when: tengo X instalado for a Python package. Do not use when: which Python versions exist (use software.python.status), normal apps (use app.installed). Examples: «¿tengo instalado numpy?», «¿qué versión de pandas tengo?», «is requests installed?».
tools.software.python.status: List the Python versions installed on the PC. Use when: qué python tengo. Do not use when: a Python package (use software.python.package.status). Examples: «¿qué versión de python tengo?», «¿está instalado python?», «python versions?».
tools.storage.removable.list: List the USB drives and pendrives connected now and their free space. Use when: hay un pendrive or cuánto espacio le queda al USB. Do not use when: the internal disk (use system.status), other peripherals (use peripheral.list). Examples: «¿hay un pendrive conectado?», «¿cuánto espacio le queda al usb?», «lista los discos externos».
tools.streaming.navigate: Go to an exact content address on a streaming service (Netflix, HBO Max, Prime Video, YouTube), without searching by title. Use when: a specific streaming link or id is already known. Do not use when: a title is named (use streaming.play.named), a YouTube search (use media.play.youtube). Examples: «abre este link de netflix: netflix.com/watch/123», «ve a esa dirección de hbo max», «open this prime video link».
tools.streaming.play.named: Play a movie or series by its title on Netflix, Disney+ or HBO Max and verify the video advances. Use when: a film or series title is named. Do not use when: music (use media.play.query or media.play.exact), YouTube videos (use media.play.youtube), only opening the Netflix app (use app.open). Examples: «pon stranger things en netflix», «quiero ver Moana en disney plus», «play The Last of Us en hbo max».
tools.system.application.crash.diagnose: Report which applications crashed or hung recently. Use when: why did an app close by itself or which apps froze. Do not use when: running processes (use system.process.list), alarms not ringing (use schedule.alarms). Examples: «¿qué aplicaciones se cayeron hoy?», «¿por qué se cerró el chrome?», «any app crashes recently?».
tools.system.identity: Read which Windows user account BAXY runs under; it does not tell the person's name. Use when: con qué usuario de Windows. Do not use when: the person's own name (use memory.recall). Examples: «¿con qué cuenta de windows corres?», «¿qué usuario de windows es este?», «whoami».
tools.system.power: Lock, sign out, sleep, shut down or restart the PC, with confirmation. Use when: apaga, reinicia, bloquea or suspende el PC. Do not use when: closing apps (use app.close or window.close.all), radios (use wifi.radio.set or bluetooth.radio.set). Examples: «apaga el pc», «reinicia el computador», «bloquea la pantalla». Never use it to silence, mute or lower sound: that is audio.mute. Turning the PC off is only for apaga/shut down.
tools.system.process.list: List running processes, sorted by CPU, memory or name. Use when: qué procesos corren or qué consume más. Do not use when: whether one app has an open window (use window.application.status), overall CPU or RAM (use system.status). Examples: «¿qué procesos usan más memoria?», «lista los programas corriendo», «top cpu processes».
tools.system.process.terminate.named: Force-kill a program by its executable name, with confirmation; this is not a normal window close. Use when: mata, fuerza el cierre or the program no responde. Do not use when: a normal close of an app (use app.close), closing all windows (use window.close.all). Examples: «fuerza el cierre de chrome.exe», «mata el proceso de spotify», «kill discord que se pegó».
tools.system.recyclebin.empty: Empty the Windows Recycle Bin. Use when: vacía la papelera. Do not use when: deleting one file (use filesystem.known.trash.named), restoring a file BAXY deleted (use filesystem.trash.restore). Examples: «vacía la papelera», «limpia la papelera de reciclaje», «empty recycle bin».
tools.system.settings.adjust: Raise or lower screen brightness by an amount from its current level. Use when: sube or baja el brillo with an amount. Do not use when: a target brightness level is given (use system.settings.set), volume (use audio.volume.adjust). Examples: «sube el brillo 20», «bájale 10 al brillo», «brightness down 15».
tools.system.settings.set: Set brightness to a level, or turn do-not-disturb, night light, airplane mode or BAXY's accessible mode on or off; can also turn BAXY's confirmation bypass off. Use when: brillo al N, no molestar, luz nocturna, modo avión. Do not use when: brightness by an amount (use system.settings.adjust), Wi-Fi or Bluetooth alone (use wifi.radio.set or bluetooth.radio.set). Examples: «pon el brillo al 70», «activa el modo avión», «prende la luz nocturna».
tools.system.settings.status: Read the current screen brightness, or whether airplane mode is on, without changing it. Use when: en cuánto está el brillo. Do not use when: changing it (use system.settings.set or system.settings.adjust). Examples: «¿en cuánto está el brillo?», «¿qué brillo tiene la pantalla?», «¿está activado el modo avión?».
tools.system.status: Read PC status: CPU, memory, disk, battery, graphics card and Windows. Use when: battery, RAM, disk or specs questions. Do not use when: per-process usage (use system.process.list), monitors (use display.status), USB drives (use storage.removable.list). Examples: «¿cuánta batería tengo?», «¿cuánta ram estoy usando?», «¿qué tarjeta gráfica tengo?».
tools.system.time: Read the current date and time, here or in another place or time zone. Use when: qué hora es or qué día es. Do not use when: weather (use weather.current), setting an alarm (use schedule.alarms), the calendar (use calendar.event.list). Examples: «¿qué hora es?», «¿qué hora es en Tokio?», «¿qué fecha es hoy?». Always use it for the time or date in another city or country; never state another place's time from memory.
tools.task.complete: Mark a to-do as done or cross an item off a list. Use when: ya lo hice or tacha X. Do not use when: deleting it (use task.delete). Examples: «marca como hecha la tarea pagar la luz», «tacha el pan de la lista del súper», «done con la tarea informe».
tools.task.create: Create a to-do or add an item to a list (shopping, pending); its optional date schedules no notification. Use when: agrega X a la lista or anota de pendiente. Do not use when: it must ring or remind at a time (use schedule.alarms), free-text notes (use note.create), a calendar event (use calendar.event.create). Examples: «agrega leche a la lista del súper», «anota de pendiente llamar al banco», «add task terminar el informe».
tools.task.delete: Delete a task or remove an item from a list, moving it to a recoverable trash. Use when: borra or quita X de la lista. Do not use when: marking it done (use task.complete), a note (use note.trash). Examples: «quita el pan de la lista», «borra la tarea informe», «delete task banco».
tools.task.list: List tasks and lists (shopping, pending): open, done or deleted. Use when: qué tengo pendiente or qué hay en la lista. Do not use when: alarms or reminders (use schedule.alarms), the calendar (use calendar.event.list), notes (use note.list). Examples: «¿qué tengo pendiente?», «léeme la lista del súper», «show completed tasks».
tools.task.reopen: Reopen a task that had been marked as done. Use when: desmarca or it was not done after all. Do not use when: restoring a deleted task (use task.restore). Examples: «reabre la tarea informe», «desmarca el pan, no lo compré», «reopen task banco».
tools.task.restore: Restore a deleted task. Use when: recupera la tarea que borré. Do not use when: reopening a completed task (use task.reopen). Examples: «recupera la tarea que borré», «restaura llamar al banco», «undelete task informe».
tools.task.search: Search the tasks whose title or details contain a text. Use when: busca en mis tareas. Do not use when: notes (use note.search), files (use file.find). Examples: «busca tareas sobre la tesis», «¿tengo alguna tarea con banco?», «search tasks informe».
tools.task.update: Change the title, details or date of a task or a list item. Use when: cambia la fecha or el nombre de la tarea X. Do not use when: marking it done (use task.complete), a note (use note.update). Examples: «cambia la tarea informe para el lunes», «renombra la tarea banco a ir al banco», «update task pan: dos marraquetas».
tools.vision.describe: Describe what is seen in a screenshot already taken (by its capture id). Use when: qué ves en la pantalla or describe la captura. Do not use when: only the text (use ocr.read), the clickable controls (use input.visible.controls), no capture exists yet (use capture.screenshot first). Examples: «¿qué ves en la captura?», «describe lo que hay en pantalla», «what's on my screen?».
tools.weather.current: Read the current weather and tomorrow's forecast, here or in a named place. Use when: clima, temperatura or va a llover. Do not use when: news (use web.news.headlines), the time (use system.time). Examples: «¿cómo está el clima?», «¿va a llover mañana en Santiago?», «weather en Valparaíso».
tools.web.download: Download a file or image from the internet into a known folder (Downloads by default), by its address or by searching an image. Use when: descarga or bájame a file or image. Do not use when: a game (use game.install.named), just viewing a page (use browser.navigate). Examples: «descarga la imagen de portada de wikipedia.org al escritorio», «bájame un meme», «download ejemplo.com/manual.pdf».
tools.web.news.headlines: Read today's news headlines, in general or on a topic. Use when: noticias or titulares. Do not use when: a factual question or general internet search (use web.search). Examples: «¿cuáles son las noticias de hoy?», «noticias de economía», «dame los titulares de deportes». Prefer it over web.search whenever the person asks for news, headlines or what happened today, on any topic.
tools.web.search: Search the internet for information or nearby places and return the results. Use when: questions about facts, people, things, prices, or places near me. Do not use when: today's headlines (use web.news.headlines), weather (use weather.current), opening a site or results page in the browser (use browser.navigate), playing YouTube (use media.play.youtube). Examples: «¿quién ganó el mundial 2014?», «busca restaurantes cerca de mí», «quien es bad bunny». It only reads information: never use it to buy, order, book, pay or do anything the person asked you to do; if no tool performs that action, say in one sentence that you don't do that. For news or headlines always use web.news.headlines.
tools.web.fetch: Read one public web page (http or https) as plain text: its title, final address and text. Use when: the person gives a link or asks what a page says, or to read a page a web.search result points to. Do not use when: looking something up (use web.search), showing the page to the person (use browser.navigate), saving a file (use web.download). Examples: «léeme esta página https://…», «¿qué dice el primer resultado?», «read https://example.com/news».
tools.wifi.connect: Connect to a saved Wi-Fi network already identified by its profile id. Use when: the network was identified earlier in the conversation. Do not use when: the network is said by name or by place such as casa or trabajo (use wifi.connect.named). Examples: «conéctate a esa red», «sí, conéctate», «connect to it».
tools.wifi.connect.named: Connect to a saved Wi-Fi network by its name or by its place (casa, trabajo, oficina). Use when: conéctate al wifi X or al de la casa. Do not use when: turning the Wi-Fi radio on (use wifi.radio.set), seeing networks around (use wifi.scan). Examples: «conéctate al wifi de la casa», «conéctate a la red MiCasa5G», «connect al wifi del trabajo».
tools.wifi.disconnect: Disconnect from the current Wi-Fi network. Use when: desconéctate del wifi. Do not use when: turning the Wi-Fi radio off (use wifi.radio.set). Examples: «desconéctate del wifi», «sal de esta red», «disconnect wifi».
tools.wifi.ensure.connected: Check that Wi-Fi is already connected, without changing anything. Use when: a step must make sure Wi-Fi is connected. Do not use when: the person simply asks whether they are connected (use wifi.status), connecting (use wifi.connect.named). Examples: «asegúrate de que el wifi esté conectado», «comprueba que sigo en el wifi», «make sure wifi is connected».
tools.wifi.profile.list: List the Wi-Fi networks saved on the PC. Use when: qué redes tengo guardadas. Do not use when: networks around now (use wifi.scan). Examples: «¿qué redes wifi tengo guardadas?», «lista mis redes guardadas», «saved wifi networks».
tools.wifi.radio.set: Turn the PC's Wi-Fi on or off, with confirmation. Use when: prende or apaga el wifi. Do not use when: leaving one network only (use wifi.disconnect), airplane mode (use system.settings.set), Bluetooth (use bluetooth.radio.set). Examples: «apaga el wifi», «prende el wifi», «turn wifi on».
tools.wifi.radio.status: Read whether Wi-Fi is on or off, without changing it. Use when: está prendido el wifi. Do not use when: whether it is connected to a network (use wifi.status). Examples: «¿está prendido el wifi?», «¿tengo el wifi activado?», «wifi on or off?».
tools.wifi.scan: List the Wi-Fi networks available around now, with their signal. Use when: qué redes hay disponibles. Do not use when: saved networks (use wifi.profile.list). Examples: «¿qué redes wifi hay disponibles?», «busca redes wifi», «scan wifi».
tools.wifi.status: Check whether the PC is connected to a Wi-Fi network right now. Use when: estoy conectado al wifi. Do not use when: general internet (use network.status), radio on or off (use wifi.radio.status). Examples: «¿estoy conectado al wifi?», «¿tengo wifi?», «wifi status».
tools.window.active: Tell which window or application is in the foreground now. Use when: qué ventana está activa or al frente. Do not use when: whether a named app is open (use window.application.status). Examples: «¿qué ventana tengo activa?», «¿qué programa está al frente?», «what window is this?».
tools.window.application.status: Check whether a named application is open with a visible window, without opening it. Use when: está abierto X. Do not use when: opening it (use app.open), whether it is installed (use app.installed), which window is in front (use window.active). Examples: «¿está abierto el spotify?», «¿tengo el chrome abierto?», «is discord open?».
tools.window.close.all: Close all open windows at once, except VS Code, the terminal and BAXY; never forces. Use when: cierra todo or todas las ventanas. Do not use when: one app (use app.close), only hiding windows to see the desktop (use window.minimize.all). Examples: «cierra todas las ventanas», «cierra todo», «close everything».
tools.window.focus: Bring an open window to the front by the windowId that window.resolve or window.active returned (never a number taken from another result). Use when: cambia a, ve a or trae al frente an open app. Do not use when: the app is not open (use app.open), maximizing (use window.maximize). Examples: «tráeme al frente el chrome», «cambia a la ventana de word», «focus spotify».
tools.window.maximize: Maximize an already identified window. Use when: maximiza or agranda la ventana. Do not use when: back to normal size (use window.restore), fullscreen video in the browser (use browser.control). Examples: «maximiza el chrome», «agranda la ventana», «maximize word».
tools.window.minimize: Minimize one already identified window, not all. Use when: minimiza X or esta ventana. Do not use when: minimizing everything to show the desktop (use window.minimize.all), closing it (use app.close). Examples: «minimiza el spotify», «minimiza esta ventana», «minimize chrome».
tools.window.minimize.all: Minimize all windows to show the desktop, closing nothing. Use when: minimiza todo or muéstrame el escritorio. Do not use when: one window (use window.minimize), closing all windows (use window.close.all). Examples: «minimiza todo», «muéstrame el escritorio», «minimize all».
tools.window.move: Move an already identified window to another position on the screen (x, y). Use when: mueve la ventana a a position. Do not use when: the left or right half (use window.snap), changing its size (use window.resize). Examples: «mueve el chrome arriba a la izquierda», «mueve la ventana a 100, 100», «move notepad a la esquina».
tools.window.resize: Resize an already identified window to a given width and height. Use when: cambia el tamaño a N por M. Do not use when: maximizing (use window.maximize), half the screen (use window.snap). Examples: «haz la ventana de 800 por 600», «cambia el tamaño del bloc de notas a 1024x768», «resize chrome to 1280x720».
tools.window.restore: Return an already identified minimized or maximized window to its normal size. Use when: restaura or devuelve la ventana a su tamaño. Do not use when: only bringing it to front (use window.focus), maximizing (use window.maximize). Examples: «restaura la ventana del chrome», «vuelve el spotify a tamaño normal», «restore word».
tools.window.snap: Place an already identified window on the left or right half of the screen. Use when: pon X a la izquierda or a la derecha. Do not use when: exact coordinates (use window.move), maximizing (use window.maximize). Examples: «pon el chrome a la izquierda», «manda el word a la mitad derecha», «snap spotify right».
tools.input.scroll: Scroll the active window or a named list or panel up or down by an amount. Use when: baja, sube or desplázate in a page, list or document on screen. Do not use when: moving the mouse pointer (use input.pointer.control), clicking a visible option (use input.visible.click). Examples: «baja un poco la página», «sube en la lista», «scroll down».
